c01|3.answer_text: In fiscal 2022 3M’s operating‑income margin slipped from 20.8% to 19.1%, a 1.7‑point decline. In addition, foreign‑currency impacts reduced operating income by about $271 million, and higher pension and post‑retirement costs added expense.
